title: Key Mapping
product-requirement: Expose required VK_* constants and map them to the corresponding remote control keys
specification: All remote control units supplied with the terminal MUST include.
assertion: VK_RED, VK_GREEN, VK_BLUE, VK_YELLOW, VK_ENTER, VK_UP, VK_DOWN, VK_LEFT and VK_RIGHT MUST exist, have numeric values and match the corresponding remote control key presses
